quoted_paragraph: With his Vienna crown, Alcaraz completed a perfect 16-0 season at ATP 500 events, a tally which includes title runs in Doha and Tokyo. The 23-year-old is on a 26-match winning streak at that level overall, having not lost an ATP 500 match since his Barcelona championship-match defeat to Holger Rune in April 2025. He trails only the 'Big Three' of Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal and Novak Djokovic on the list of ATP 500 titles won.
